description: Source code for the FuzzedSocket class, a mock socket implementation used for fuzz testing within the Chromium project. It simulates socket behavior, errors, and asynchronous operations for testing purposes.

classes.name: FuzzedSocket
classes.description: A mock socket class used for fuzz testing, simulating socket operations, errors, and asynchronous behavior.

methods.name: FuzzedSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fuzzed socket with data provider and net log.

methods.name: ~FuzzedSocket
methods.description: Default destructor.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Simulates reading data from the socket, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Simulates writing data to the socket, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size (stub implementation).

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size (stub implementation).

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address (not implemented).

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Simulates connecting the socket, with possible success or failure, asynchronously.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket and resets state.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address if connected.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address if connected.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log associated with the socket.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket was ever used for reading or writing.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN was negotiated (always false here).

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol (unknown here).

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL info (not implemented).

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag (stub).

methods.name: ConsumeReadWriteErrorFromData
methods.description: Selects a read/write error from predefined errors.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon read completion.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon write completion.

methods.name: OnConnectComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon connect completion.

methods.name: ForceSync
methods.description: Determines if operations should be forced to be synchronous based on activity count.
